title: TSE alerts voters about the importance of checking their polling station
seoTitle: TSE alerts voters to check polling station early
subtitle: Court reinforces warning less than eight days before the first round of elections.
excerpt: Less than eight days before the first round, TSE urges voters to verify their polling station due to possible address changes.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Less than eight days before the first round of elections, the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) issued an important alert aimed at Brazilian voters. The recommendation is that the public check their polling station in advance.

The body emphasizes that voters should verify the information ahead of time, as the electoral section may have changed address since the last election.

Prior verification avoids hassles and ensures citizens know exactly where to go on voting day, guaranteeing the full exercise of citizenship within the timeframe set by the electoral calendar.

With information from Agência Brasil.
